place: Kamalasagar Kali Temple and Border Haat
text: Kamalasagar is an artificial lake in Tripura, India, constructed by King Dhanya Manikya of Tripura in the 15th century and is a popular spot for picnickers. A mela is held there every October during the Navaratri festival.
best_time: October to April (dry season with vibrant festivals like Hornbill, Bihu, and Wangala)
